y-m-41-05.topic: Chimiro chinodzokororwa mu powers ye matrix nerenji rinogona kupfuvurwa mutemo
y-m-41-05.goal: Fanofungidzira mutemo mu powers ye matrix, chinja kufanofungidzira nechivimbo zvichienderana nemhedzisiro itsva yekuverenga, uye utonge kana mutemo wakawanikwa we matrix imwe ungatamiswa kune imwe matrix.
y-m-41-05.material: A ndi matrix ye 2×2 ine mutsara wekutanga (0, −1) nemutsara wechipiri (1, 0). E ndiyo identity matrix (mutsara wekutanga (1, 0), mutsara wechipiri (0, 1)), uye −E ndiyo matrix ine zviratidzo zve entries dzose dzakachinjwa. A² ndi A yakawedzerwa kaviri (A squared), uye A³ ndi A yakawedzerwa katatu. Sezvo data ichiratidzwa rimwe panguva, chinja kufunga kwako nezve chimiro chinobuda kana tichiramba tichitora powers.
y-m-41-05.thinking.0: Fanofungidzira mhedzisiro inotevera uchishandisa mhedzisiro yatowanikwa
y-m-41-05.thinking.1: Chinja kutonga nechivimbo zvichienderana ne data itsva
y-m-41-05.thinking.2: Ongorora kana mutemo wemuenzaniso mumwe ungawedzerwa kunyaya dzose

y-m-41-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kufanofungidzira nguva imwe neimwe data painoratidzwa. Mushure mekuona data itsva, unogona kuchinja kufunga kwako.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.hint.0: Edza kuona kana unogona kushandisa zvakare powers dzawatowana kuti uwane power inotevera.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora A, A², A³, A⁴ nenhevedzano mutafura uye utsvage nzvimbo apo chimiro chimwe chete chinoonekwa zvakare.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana A² yaverengwa, yakava −E (mutsara wekutanga (−1, 0), mutsara wechipiri (0, −1)), ine entries pa diagonal chete.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: A³ ne A⁴ dzichava chii? Sarudza kufanofungidzira kwakakodzera zvakanyanya kubva pa data yaripo.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.after: A³=A²A=(−E)A=−A uye A⁴=A²A²=(−E)(−E)=E. Kana ukashandisazve mhedzisiro yawatowana, unogona kufanofungidzira pasina kuwedzera zvakananga, uye unogona kutarisa kufanofungidzira uku nekuwedzera.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ma entries anoramba achikura, saka ma entries e A⁴ achava neabsolute value hombe kupfuura eA²
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kuti saizi yema entries inochinja sei inobva pachimiro che product. Verenga kuti chokwadi chekuti A² ndi −E chinokanganisa sei ma products anotevera.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A³=−A uye A⁴=E. Unogona kungoshandisazve A² yawatowana
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafanofungidzira pasina kuwedzera zvakananga, nekushandisazve mhedzisiro yawawana.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: A³ zvakare ndi −E uye A⁴ zvakare ndi −E, saka icharamba iri −E
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Zvinoratidzika kuti wakafunga kuti sezvo A² iri −E, dzinotevera dziri kukosha kumwe chete. Tarisa kuti unowana chii kana ukawedzera (−E) ne A kana ne (−E).
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Haugoni kutaura chimwe chinhu nezve A³ usati wawedzera zvakananga
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Tarisa kana unogona kushandisa A² yauri kuziva kare. Pangava nezvinhu zvaunogona kuziva pasina kuwedzera zvakare.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ndakatarisa nekuwedzera zvakananga. A³ ine mutsara wekutanga (0, 1) nemutsara wechipiri (−1, 0), uye A⁴=E.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Saka A²⁰²⁶ (A kumhaka ye2026), A yakawedzerwa ka2026, ndi matrix ipi?
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Sezvo A⁴=E, inodzokera ku E nguva dzose A inowedzerwa ka4. 2026 nguva ndimapoka e4 506 ne2 dzasara, saka A²⁰²⁶=A²=−E. Izvi zvinokonzerwa nekuti unogona kuita mapoka emaproducts uchishandisa associative law.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakashandisa chimiro chekuti inodzokera ku E nguva dzose 4 uye wakaverenga huwandu hwasara.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Zvinoratidzika kuti wakafunga kuti ndi E nekuti 2026 iri even. A² yaiva −E. Powers dzose dziri even hadzisi E.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Pamwe wakafunga kudaro nekuti A ine chimiro chayo chekutanga. Tanga watarisa kuti inodzokera ku E pakuwedzera kupi uchiwedzera ka2026.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uchishandisa mhedzisiro A⁴=E, hauna kudikanwa kuwedzera ka2026 imwe imwe. Tarisa kuti kuwedzera kunoitwa kangani kuti pattern idzokorore.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Shamwari inoti, "Kana ukawedzera matrix ye 2×2 kakawanda zvakakwana, pakupedzisira inodzokera ku E." Wakawedzera imwe matrix C (mutsara wekutanga (2, 0), mutsara wechipiri (0, 1)): C² ine mutsara wekutanga (4, 0) nemutsara wechipiri (0, 1), uye C³ ine mutsara wekutanga (8, 0) nemutsara wechipiri (0, 1).
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Entry yemutsara 1, column 1 ye C ndi2, 4, 8, ichiwedzera kaviri nguva imwe neimwe (chimiro che 2 kumhaka ye n). Kana mutemo uyu uchienderera, C haidzokeri ku E. 'A inodzokorora nguva dzose 4' chokwadi chinoreva A, kwete chimiro che matrices ose. Kuvimba kwaunoita mumutemo kunoenderana neumboo (kana wakatarisa zvakananga).
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: A yakadzokera ku E, saka C ichava E pakupedzisira kana ikawedzerwa kashoma zvakare
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatamisa mutemo we matrix imwe kune imwe matrix. Tarisa kuti entries dzemutsara 1, column 1 dze C² ne C³ dzinochinja sei.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: A kudzokera ku E kwaiva kuenderana, saka mhedzisiro ye A haigoni kuvimbwa zvakare
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: A⁴=E mhedzisiro yakatariswa nekuwedzera zvakananga. Siyanisa zvakasimbiswa kune matrix imwe nekupfuvura kune matrices ose.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: C haioneki ichidzokera ku E, saka chirevo cheshamwari chinonetsa kutenda
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hauna kushandisa mutemo wakawanikwa kune matrix imwe sezvawakaita kune imwe matrix, uye wakaupima ne data itsva.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Wakangoona C katatu, saka haugoni kuita kutonga kwakadai
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Mumhedzisiro yenguva 3, unogona kuona shanduko yakarongeka apo mutsara 1, column 1 inowedzera kaviri. Funga kuti unogona kutaura chii kubva pashanduko iyoyo.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.reflect: Chivimbo chako chakachinja sei kana waiziva A² chete, kana waiziva kusvika ku A⁴, uye mushure mekuona C? Ndinguva ipi yaunogona kuvimba nemutemo unodzokororwa, uye ndinguva ipi yaunoda kutarisa zvakawanda?
y-m-41-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kuchirevo cheshamwari. Mumutsara mumwe kana miviri, nyora kuti wakawana sei A²⁰²⁶ uye nei nzira iyoyo isingagoni kushandiswa kune C sezvayakaita.

y-m-41-06.title: Shamwari mbiri dzisingabvumirani nezve inverse matrix ye AB
y-m-41-06.topic: Inverse matrix ye product ye matrices maviri: kurongeka kwekuwedzera ma inverse matrices
y-m-41-06.goal: Enzanisa mafomula maviri akasarudzwa uchishandisa muenzaniso mumwe, siyanisa zvinogona nezvisingagoni kuratidzwa nemuenzaniso mumwe, wozotsanangura neletters kurongeka kwekuwedzera ma inverse matrices kune ma matrices ose.
y-m-41-06.material: A ine mutsara wekutanga (1, 2) nemutsara wechipiri (0, 1), uye B ine mutsara wekutanga (1, 0) nemutsara wechipiri (3, 1). Vose vane ma inverse matrices. Inverse matrix ye A ine mutsara wekutanga (1, −2) nemutsara wechipiri (0, 1), uye inverse matrix ye B ine mutsara wekutanga (1, 0) nemutsara wechipiri (−3, 1). Product AB ine mutsara wekutanga (7, 2) nemutsara wechipiri (3, 1). Haeun anoti, "Inverse matrix ye AB ndiyo inverse matrix ye A inotevedzwa neinverse matrix ye B," uye Doyun anoti, "Unofanira kuwedzera inverse matrix ye B inotevedzwa neinverse matrix ye A." Daidza matrix yakaverengwa nefomula yaHaeun kuti X (mutsara wekutanga (7, −2), mutsara wechipiri (−3, 1)), uye matrix yakaverengwa nefomula yaDoyun kuti Y (mutsara wekutanga (1, −2), mutsara wechipiri (−3, 7)).
y-m-41-06.thinking.1: Siyanisa zvinogona kuramba nemuenzaniso mumwe nezvisingagoni kupedzisa
y-m-41-06.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa nekuwedzera AB ne X uye ne Y. Inverse matrix ye AB ndeipi?
y-m-41-06.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga matrix ye AB kuwedzera X uye matrix ye AB kuwedzera Y.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa, entry neentry, kana mhedzisiro yawakaverenga yakaenzana neidentity matrix (mutsara wekutanga (1, 0), mutsara wechipiri (0, 1)).
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.a: Y chete ndiyo inverse matrix ye AB
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.a: Uku kutonga kunoshandisa umboo hwekuwedzera musarudzwa zvakananga uye kutarisa kana ichipa identity matrix.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.b: X ne Y zvose ndema inverse matrices e AB
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.b: Inverse matrix imatrix inopa identity matrix kana yawedzerwa, uye iripo imwe chete. Tanga wanyatsoenzanisa kana X ne Y dziri matrix imwe chete.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.c: X chete ndiyo inverse matrix ye AB
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.c: Tarisazve kana wakatarisa entries ina dzose kusvika pakupedzisira kana X yawedzerwa ne AB kuti utarise kana ichipa identity matrix.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.d: Hapana X kana Y inoita inverse matrix ye AB
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.d: Kana imwe yakarurama asi wakati hapana, pangava neentry apo kuverenga kwakatsauka. Verenga zvakare ma products maviri.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.explain: (AB)Y ine mutsara wekutanga (1, 0) nemutsara wechipiri (0, 1), saka ndiyo identity matrix, asi (AB)X haisi identity matrix. Saka mumuenzaniso uyu inverse matrix ye AB ndi Y.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.prompt: Ungataura chii kubva pamhedzisiro yemuenzaniso uyu mumwe?
y-m-41-06.s.s2.hint.0: Mumuenzaniso uyu, tanga watarisa kana matrix yakawanikwa nefomula yaHaeun yakava inverse matrix.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kana chokwadi chekuti fomula yaDoyun yakarurama chiri umboo hwekuti yakarurama kune A ne B dzose.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.o.a: Fomula yaDoyun inogara yakarurama. Nekuti yakarurama mumuenzaniso uyu
y-m-41-06.s.s2.r.a: Muenzaniso mumwe kuva wakarurama hazvireve kuti wakarurama munyaya dzose. Funga kuti unotarisa sei kana pane nyaya apo fomula yaDoyun inogona kukanganisa.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.o.b: Fomula yaHaeun haigari yakarurama. Kuti fomula yaDoyun inogara yakarurama here zvinofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana neletters
y-m-41-06.s.s2.r.b: Yakasiyanisa zvinogona kuramba nemuenzaniso mumwe nezvisingagoni kusimbiswa.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.o.c: Mafomula ose mbiri dzimwe nguva akarurama uye dzimwe nguva akashata, saka nzira chete ndeyekuverenga zvakananga uye kutarisa nguva imwe neimwe
y-m-41-06.s.s2.r.c: Muenzaniso uyu wakaratidza kuti fomula yaHaeun inogona kukanganisa. Asi nyaya apo fomula yaDoyun yakashata haisati yaratidzwa.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.o.d: X ne Y chaizvo ndi matrix imwe chete, saka hauna kudikanwa kufunga nezvekurongeka kwekuwedzera
y-m-41-06.s.s2.r.d: Enzanisa ma entries emutsara 1, column 1 e X ne Y. Tanga watarisa kana ari matrix imwe chete.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.explain: Fomula yaHaeun haina kupa inverse matrix ye AB mumuenzaniso uyu, saka haisi fomula inogara yakarurama (muenzaniso unopikisa).
